OPERATOR CONSOLE — desktop 1440x900
Live map, children & schedule, routes & geofences.

PARENT APP — mobile 390x844
Active ride, lost signal, quiet state, sign-in.

ParentLive and ParentStale are the same moment of the same ride. Without the second one a dead feed looks identical to a healthy one.

Names, schools, phone numbers, IMEI and coordinates are sample values — replace with real data before this goes in front of the client.

The only real facts here: the gym's address and front-desk number from the website.
